verdict_reason: Correctly fakes OIDC discovery at the network boundary instead of mocking an own module, but the workspace testing guide still prescribes the vi.mock route it replaces.

todos.issue: answerOidcDiscovery replaces the vi.mock of get-oidc-config.js with a nock at the network boundary (and the PR deletes that vi.mock from health/controller.test.js), but the workspace testing guide still prescribes the old mechanism: docs/best-practices/node/testing/frontend.md section 2 table row 'Config and OIDC discovery when a server starts: vi.mock ... of get-oidc-config.js returning mockOidcConfig' and section 6 'OIDC discovery (mockOidcConfig) and auth config (mockAuthConfig) are the only module mocks a server test may use', with the vi.mock example. The pattern changed and its recipe was left behind, so the next server test follows the guide back to a module mock.
todos.fix: Must: the testing guide says how a real-mode ins-frontend server test answers OIDC discovery the way this repo now does it (a nock of the discovery URL returning mockOidcConfig, via answerOidcDiscovery / startRealModeServer), and no longer presents a vi.mock of get-oidc-config.js as the required route for it. One way: update the section 2 row and the section 6 server-test example in the same cross-repo change.
